On the HAR benchmark the three closing-interval linear models hold the same position as one another; they differ from the closing-interval OLS, rebuilt under the current data rules, on at most 32 days. Panel C gives medians across the closing-interval tree pairs (every hyperparameter specification in the model
set) and across all pairs of the \rheModelSetN{} forecasts of the model set, with the number of pairs whose
Sharpe ratio difference is significantly positive at the 5\% level in brackets (none is significantly negative at that level). $^{*}$, $^{**}$ and $^{***}$ denote significance at the 10\%, 5\% and 1\% levels.
